_note: The beat runner's script (cine/beats.gd, design/typical-day.md section 2). A sequence is an ordered list of beats. A beat starts by applying `allow` (player.allow: only these actions work; [] everything, ["none"] nothing; names are input actions or their family, move and look; a beat without `allow` keeps the last one; the sequence's end allows everything), running `do`, giving PIP its `pip` order, emitting its `task` (a line id for the Today list, kept until the next one), its `objective` ("pip", a landmark or an item id; null clears it) and its `line` (an id the HUD looks up) with opts {keys: `keys`, fact: `fact`}, then waits; when `wait` is met (or after `max_s`) it emits beat_done(id) and the next beat starts, or the one named in `then` ("end" stops the sequence). wait: {time: s} | {place: {at, r}} (the hero within r m of a spot) | {action: name or [names]} | {event: name or [names]} (a list waits for all); `fact: true` also waits for "dismissed" (the HUD's Enter or tap). Actions and events all arrive through notify(name): jump and look (the view turned look_deg) are watched by the runner, and so are move_forward, move_back, move_left, move_right and hurry (held hold_s, hurry only while really hurrying); lift and use:<what> come from the interactions, pip_arrived from PIP, chose:<id> from the rules, dismissed, map_open and map_closed from the HUD, shot_done:<name> from the cinematics. A beat with a job for the kid (keys, a fact, an objective or `nag`) pleads when ignored: at nag.at_s PIP says nag.lines (or the beat's own `nag` ids) with the beat's keys, and plays sounds and the sad bounce by level; the beat's line comes back after back_s; getting nearer a place by 1 m calms it. While PIP leads (follow_me) it calls pip.call_line every call_s. pip: go_to (drive and park; wave and point_at then happen on arrival), follow_me (lead there at the hero's pace: full speed while the hero is within lead_near_m, slowing to a stop at lead_wait_m, going on within lead_resume_m), point_at (stop and look), wave. While the beats hold PIP, a hero walking into it makes it back off once within back_m plus back_lead_s seconds of the hero's closing speed (at most back_s). do: clock:dawn (jump the look to dawn and pin it), clock:<hour> (put the look at that hour of this sol and pin it), clock:run (let it run), clock:skip (the time-lapse to the next phase), open:<item> (open its door), close:<item> (shut it, interactions.set_door), shot:<name> (a camera shot: dawn_reveal, focus_pip, look_around), hero:<start> (put the hero at a `starts` row), walk:<spot> (the hero walks there on its own at walk speed through the real controller, input still blocked; the spot as "x,z" or an id; it ends with the beat, so wait on the place), ghost:on|off (the Earth jump beside the hero), offer:<choice id> (choice_offered; the rules own it). A spot is [x, z], a PIP stop id (world.json pip.stops), a landmark, an item id, `pip` or `hero`; a look point is [x, z, height], a stop id (its look), an item id or `hero`. All numbers here are art direction. The opening wakes at clock:5.8, pre-dawn (the sun 3 deg under the horizon, blue twilight, not night): the sun clears the crater rim at about 06:08 seen from dawn_reveal's wide view (cine.gd sunrise_hour()), and the shot runs the clock on so it breaks over the rim while the kid watches, however slowly the walk-out went (the walk is automatic). At the old clock:dawn (06:19) the sun was already 3 deg over the rim

ghost._note: the faint hero beside the real one doing the same hop on Earth (cine/beats_ghost.gd): color a DESIGN.md token, alpha its opacity, side_m to the hero's right, linger_s shown after it lands (the hero is still in the air for about 0.4 s of it)

airlock._note: inside HAB 1, at its door, facing out, clear of the hatch's inward swing (item space; the model's door is on its -Z front)

nag._note: PIP ignored: the plea times (s since the step began or the kid last got nearer), its lines and sounds by level (audio.gd SOUNDS names), the sad bounce at level 3 (s, m up, bounces a second, head down)

offers._note: Each choice a beat offers (offer:<id>): the card's title line id, its options (text line id, the rules sim choices it applies, costs shown as icons). Costs stay empty until each number has a factcheck row (workspace hard rule 3).
